I've revised the spec with everything you asked for. **Still at the spec gate** — no planning or code until you approve.

## 📄 Updated specification — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`

### What changed from v1

| Your request | How it's now in the spec |
|---|---|
| Auto page details (title, description, favicon, preview image), editable title/description | **US1** + FR-003, FR-004; fallback when unfetchable (FR-005) |
| Preserved page snapshot, PDFs kept as PDFs | New **US2** (P1) + FR-006–FR-008 |
| Read-later status + unread view | New **US4** + FR-014 |
| Reversible archive + archive view, distinct from delete | New **US6** + FR-016, FR-017 |
| Sort by date added and title | Folded into **US3** + FR-013 (both asc/desc) |
| Duplicate address → edit existing, not a copy | New **US7** + FR-018 (covers archived duplicates too) |
| Saved notes | New **US5** + FR-015 (also searchable) |
| Standard import/export in v1 | New **US8** + FR-020–FR-022 |

Also added: **Snapshot** and updated **Bookmark** entities, and new success criteria (SC-002 auto-fill rate, SC-004 snapshot reopen, SC-006 zero duplicates, SC-007 archive/restore, SC-008 export→re-import).

### Confirmed out of scope (per your note)
Folders, favorites, user accounts, and ongoing link-health checks.

### Two decisions baked in as assumptions — please confirm

1. **"Standard bookmark format" = the HTML bookmark file** that browsers import/export (Chrome, Firefox, Safari all speak it). On import, **nested folders map to tags** (since you don't want folders). Good, or did you have a different format in mind?
2. **Snapshots and details are captured once at save time** — no automatic re-capture. Matches your "no ongoing link-health checks."

---

Two things worth a moment before you approve:

- **Preview image vs. snapshot** are distinct: the preview image is a thumbnail shown in the list; the snapshot is the full preserved page. Both are in scope — just flagging so it's intentional.
- Anything on **snapshot scope** you'd want to pin down (e.g., is capturing a static rendering of the page enough, or do you expect interactive elements preserved)? I've left it as "content as it was at save time," which favors a faithful static capture.

Reply with approval or edits. Once approved, next gate is **speckit-plan** (or I can run **speckit-clarify** first to tighten the snapshot/import details).
